_purpose: Ratchet for the Stage A donor-UI mirror corpora. documents/without-errors are measured by eng/cui-mirror/probe under --strict; any CUI compile error fails. A fall in `documents` means mirrors were lost and must be explained, not absorbed.
evidence_label: CUI compile evidence only. Nothing here is rendered, run natively, packaged or accepted.
_change_reason: 2026-10-31: corpora regenerated from per-app donor trees (Data now mirrors Data/Source/LibreOffice/sc, Present mirrors Present/Source/LibreOffice/sd, instead of borrowing Write's checkout) after a bad rm -rf removed the Present and Data trees; each app's donor binding now owns its own path, pin and digest. +1 document from the first AppFlowy frontend pass (1 of 18 files: its board UI is Dart code-built widgets, so 17 files stay recorded untranslated until a Dart dialect exists). Gitea is 289 rather than 292 because the Go template handling changed: control tags no longer leak, and three files whose template branch tags leave an unbalanced tree are now reported untranslated instead of being mirrored with invented structure.
